verses.1: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.2: And the land was dark and gloomy, with nothing but darkness all around. The spirit of God hovered over the surface of the waters.
verses.3: And God said, “Let there be light.” And there was light.
verses.4: And God saw that the light was good. So God separated the light from the darkness.
verses.5: And God called out to the light of the day, and to the darkness, He called out to the night. And there was one day, with morning and evening.
verses.6: And God said, “Let there be a cloud in the midst of the water, so that it may separate the water from the land.”
verses.7: And God made the sky, and He separated the waters that were below the sky from the waters that were above it. And so it was.
verses.8: And God called to the sky, and there was evening. Then there was morning, on the second day.
verses.9: And God said, “Let the waters flow from below the heavens to one place only. Then you will see the rainbow appear.” And so it was.
verses.10: And God called out to the land and to the waters. He called out to the seas, and God saw that it was good.
verses.11: And God said, “Let the earth produce vegetation—plants and seeds of trees that will bear fruit. Let them produce fruits according to their kinds, as God has commanded.” And so it was.
verses.12: And the earth produced grass, plants of various kinds, and trees that bore fruit. Their seeds were of various kinds. And God saw that it was good.
verses.13: And it became evening, and then morning came on the third day.
verses.14: And God said, “Let there be light in the sky, so that it may distinguish between day and night. Let there be lights for various purposes, for different times and seasons.”
verses.15: And they shall be lights in the heavens, to shine upon the earth. And that will be the case.
verses.16: And God made the two great lights: the greater light for governing the day, and the smaller light for governing the night. He also created the stars.
verses.17: And God placed them in the sky, so that they could illuminate the earth.
verses.18: And he saw day and night, and distinguished between light and darkness. And God saw that it was good.
verses.19: And it became evening, and then morning came on the fourth day.
verses.20: And God said, “Let the waters divide themselves, so that dry land may appear on the earth, beneath the heavens of heaven.”
verses.21: And God created the great whales, and all kinds of living creatures that swam in the waters, according to their kinds. He also created every kind of bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.22: And God blessed them, saying, “Let them multiply and increase in number. Let the waters be filled with fish, and let the land be populated.”
verses.23: And it became evening, and then morning came on the fifth day.
verses.24: And God said, “Let there be living creatures of every kind in the land. There will be animals and birds, and there will also be other creatures that live on the earth.” And so it was done.
verses.25: And God created the earth according to its kind, and he created the animals according to their kinds. He also created all the creatures that live on the earth according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
verses.26: And God said, “Let us create man in our image, according to our likeness. Let him live in the waters of the sea, on the land, in the trees, and in all creatures that live on the earth.”
verses.27: And God created man in His own image, in the image of God. He created him male and female.
verses.28: And God blessed them, and said to them, “Let us multiply and fill the earth. Let us take possession of all its fruits and flowers. Let us dwell in the seas and skies, and in all the living things that live on the earth.”
verses.29: And God said, “Now, I have given you all the grass that grows on the face of the earth. And all the trees whose fruit can be eaten will also be yours.”
verses.30: And to every living creature on the earth, and to every bird in the heavens, and to every beast that crawls on the earth, I will give them food from all the plants that grow on the earth. And so it shall be.
verses.31: And God saw all that He had created. And behold, it was very good. Then came evening and morning, on the sixth day.
